notes: Article, numeral and noun are aligned pairwise under rule 13 rather than merged into a shared noun phrase.
οὔπω → not yet heads on yet under rule 66's compound arm, the negative οὐ being the prefixed element; heading on not remains the competing reading and is what the note records.
πόσους → how many heads on many, following rule 104's degree correlatives (ὅσαι → how many soever be on many).
took up keeps the phrasal particle inside the verb's unit, the object κοφίνους being accusative.
